anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
What should the report view do with active filters when the user switches workspaces?
A) clear all filters on every workspace switch
B) preserve all active filters across switches, which is today's behavior in the workspace-change handler
C) restore each workspace's last filters
Recommendation: C - filters usually depend on the workspace's data, so restoring each workspace's last filters avoids carrying stale selections across workspaces without making users rebuild their view.
